data.name: Bilal
data.gender_notes: Bilal is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ب-ل-ل (b-l-l), 'to moisten, refresh'. Bilāl means 'moistening' or 'refreshing'. Its root is ب-ل-ل (b-l-l). Borne by Bilāl ibn Rabāḥ, the first muezzin of Islam. Bilal is a Arabic name meaning “Moistening; refreshing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bilal expresses “Moistening; refreshing”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ب-ل-ل (b-l-l), 'to moisten, refresh'. Bilāl means 'moistening' or 'refreshing'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bilal total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
